# /advancement grant|revoke: every mode, criterion forms, errors, counts. Packets: update_advancements, select_advancement_tab.
!packets ^(update_advancements|select_advancement_tab)$
# permissions
@bot0 advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/root
# argument errors
advancement
advancement grant
advancement grant Nobody everything
advancement grant Bot
advancement grant Bot sideways
advancement grant Bot only
advancement grant Bot only minecraft:nope/nothing
advancement grant Bot only story/root nonexistent_criterion
advancement revoke Bot only story/root nonexistent_criterion
advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/root crafting_table extra
# revoke before anything is granted (failures)
advancement revoke Bot only minecraft:story/root
advancement revoke Bot everything
advancement revoke Bot from minecraft:story/root
advancement revoke @a through minecraft:story/mine_stone
advancement revoke Bot only minecraft:story/mine_stone get_stone
# single advancement, one player
advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/root
advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/root
advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/mine_stone get_stone
advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/mine_stone get_stone
advancement revoke Bot only minecraft:story/mine_stone get_stone
advancement revoke Bot only minecraft:story/mine_stone get_stone
# many players
advancement grant @a only minecraft:story/root
advancement grant @a only minecraft:story/root crafting_table
advancement revoke @a only minecraft:story/root crafting_table
advancement grant @a only minecraft:story/root crafting_table
advancement revoke @a only minecraft:story/root
advancement revoke @a only minecraft:story/root
# modes on a chain: root -> mine_stone -> upgrade_tools -> smelt_iron -> iron_tools
advancement grant Bot from minecraft:story/mine_stone
advancement grant Bot from minecraft:story/mine_stone
advancement revoke Bot until minecraft:story/upgrade_tools
advancement revoke Bot until minecraft:story/upgrade_tools
advancement grant Bot until minecraft:story/upgrade_tools
advancement grant Bot through minecraft:story/smelt_iron
advancement grant @a through minecraft:story/smelt_iron
advancement revoke Bot through minecraft:story/upgrade_tools
advancement revoke @a from minecraft:story/root
advancement grant @a until minecraft:story/root
advancement revoke @a only minecraft:story/root
# the selector option
execute if entity @a[advancements={minecraft:story/root=true}] run say yes root
execute if entity @a[advancements={minecraft:story/root=false}] run say no root
execute if entity @a[advancements={minecraft:story/root={crafting_table=true}}] run say crit
execute if entity @a[advancements={minecraft:story/root=true,minecraft:story/mine_stone=false}] run say mixed
execute if entity @a[advancements={minecraft:nope/nothing=true}] run say unknown
# everything
advancement grant Bot everything
advancement grant Bot everything
advancement grant @a everything
advancement revoke Bot everything
advancement revoke Bot everything
advancement grant Bot everything
advancement revoke @a everything
# return values
scoreboard objectives add adv_n dummy
execute store result score Bot adv_n run advancement grant Bot only minecraft:story/root
scoreboard players get Bot adv_n
execute store result score Bot adv_n run advancement grant Bot from minecraft:story/root
scoreboard players get Bot adv_n
execute store result score Bot adv_n run advancement revoke @a everything
scoreboard players get Bot adv_n
